anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: A broad, smooth convex spline with a high radius of curvature extending from the blowhole region toward the rostrum.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Visible beak is short and robust, with a pixel length-to-thickness ratio of approximately 1.3:1 and a rounded distal tip.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: An obtuse interior angle of approximately 140 degrees located at the pixel junction where the melon's downward curve meets the rostrum's base.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Thin, hypopigmented linear pixel clusters indicating superficial scarring on the lateral flank and near the posterior base of the pectoral fin.
other_distinctive_markers: Dark circumorbital pigment patch; mottled teal-to-grey epidermal gradient across the visible torso.
